info.title: ItemStage API
info.description:
Full-featured REST API for ItemStage workspaces: jobs, locations and areas, team, items, stage moves, location moves, questions and answers, dispositions, photos, templates, workflow settings and API keys.

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer isk_live_…`. Create keys in the app under Settings → API keys (owner or admin), or with POST /api-keys using an admin-scoped key.

Every request runs as the user who created the key, under the same row-level security and workflow gates as the app. A key can never do more than its creator can.

Scopes: `read` (GET), `write` (create/update/move/answer/photos), `admin` (keys, workflow settings, dispositions, stage names). `admin` implies `write` implies `read`.
